WITH d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999
),
d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
),
d3 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
),
facts AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_store_sk,
           MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
           MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
           MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
        AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    JOIN d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       MAX(facts.store_sales_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(facts.store_returns_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(facts.catalog_sales_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM facts
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = facts.ss_item_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = facts.ss_store_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
